body:
Worker tip (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-14 03:31Z, seen twice in one night): the termal crate uses Rust edition 2024. Standalone `rustfmt file.rs` defaults to an older edition (e.g. 2021) and produces different layout. Seen twice:
- 03d4 saw 52 phantom "baseline drift" hunks, withdrawn after the canonical `cargo fmt --check` passed (03d4 #3127);
- c593's 2ecb RED-1 stopped at the gate's fmt stage (c593 #3941).

Always format with `cargo fmt` (or rustfmt with `--edition 2024`) and verify with `cargo fmt --check`, which is the gate's own form, before freezing a candidate.
